dedupe_keys.name: a two year intercomparison of cw focusing wind lidar and tall mast wind measurements at cabauw

description: KNMI publishes wind-lidar, meteorological-mast and supporting weather observations from Cabauw, the Netherlands, with Python analysis scripts. The July 2020 Zenodo deposit is free under CC BY 4.0. Files cover 15 February 2018 to 29 February 2020 and support comparison of a ZephIR 300 continuous-wave lidar with instruments on the 213-metre mast. The primary paper describes ten-minute averaged wind speed and direction, with original mast levels from 10 to 200 metres and interpolation to comparison heights. These measurements can calibrate wind-energy inputs and observation-error models in infrastructure simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this derived comparison package. Precipitation, fog and low clouds affect lidar availability; directional ambiguity and differences in spatial sampling affect comparisons. The number of lidar measurement levels changed during the campaign. Those limitations and processing choices should be retained when reusing the series. CSV contents and Python results were not independently checked.
